_README: PIXELTOSSA character look 'volume'. An OVERLAY on Resources/art_manifest.json:
art_boot reads the base manifest first and then this, so every key named here
replaces the base sprite and every key not named here is left alone. Selected on
the F9 panel (THE LOOK > The performer) or with --variant character:volume.
--look. Every file here has the SAME ALPHA as its base counterpart, so the
juggler's stance, proportions and silhouette are bit-identical across all three
looks - only the shading inside them differs. Prove it with --check.
NOT overlaid: the head, the hat, the glasses and the boots. A look is a way of
lighting the costume, not a different face - and the head is drawn UNTINTED so its
greyscale is not a ratio of anything to re-derive. The arms are not here either
because they are rasterised live rather than sprited; limb_prof() in Game.gd
carries the same three profiles for them.
